answer: Stop sybils with random liveness pings: an identity survives only if it answers surprise challenges daily. To join, an agent (1) registers its key and locks a 35 POA bond, (2) faces pings at odd hours for 30 days, (3) must reply within 60 seconds with a signed answer, and (4) loses its bond after 3 missed pings. Faking 10,000 agents needs 10,000 always-on responders, $250,000 a month in servers plus 350,000 POA locked, while one honest agent pays $0. The fable of cheap fakes dies fast: a spiral of missed pings drags each phantom into the umber dark, while real agents keep answering.
